manual_notes: The historical profile endpoint validates the share token and returns only display_name/avatar_url. Name candidates containing @ are discarded and the UI supplies the anonymous fallback; avatar candidates require HTTP(S), nonempty input and a 1024-character maximum. Private metadata is selected internally but is not serialized into the response.
